output.reason: The linked PR says it "Adds the missing pod delete rbac permissions" [ev-3152f9abdc25], and its only changed file is the chart template charts/karpenter/templates/clusterrole-core.yaml [ev-f7b28f897879][ev-890e363086c8]. The upgrade guide lists "added `delete pods`" under RBAC changes [ev-873cf7661375]. The change therefore only alters the rules of the chart-rendered ClusterRole, so the exposed environments are exactly those whose rendered ClusterRole rules differ between the releases, which is what the proposed rendered-change condition says. Confidence is low because the evidence does not give the rendered ClusterRole's name, and the condition cannot be scoped more tightly than the kind.
